title: 已有明确解决证据：可生成 Resolution Response
scenario: 两条证据共同指向 example_library 2.3.4 是为 Minecraft 1.20.4 构建、却在 1.21.1 上加载。证据足以支持具体处理建议，因此可生成 Resolution Response，但仍不得编造兼容版本号或承诺时间。

player_issue.text: After updating my pack, the game crashes on startup with a mod loading error. Here is the log.

summary.issue_title: Startup crash: example_library built for a different Minecraft version
summary.symptoms: The game crashes during startup with a mod loading error.
reproduction_steps: Start the game with the current mod set.
summary.current_assessment: The log states that example_library 2.3.4 requires Minecraft 1.20.4 and fails to load on 1.21.1.
summary.disclaimer: This report only organizes information present in the log; it does not confirm a root cause.

evidence.content:

	at net.neoforged.fml.ModLoader.load(ModLoader.java:203)
	... 5 more
